sloka: निरीक्ष्य अनुगताम् सेनाम् ताम् च गन्गाम् शिव उदकाम् ।भरतः सचिवान् सर्वान् अब्रवीद् वाक्य कोविदः ॥२-८३-२२॥
transliteration: nirīkṣya anugatām senām tām ca gangām śiva udakām ।bharataḥ sacivān sarvān abravīd vākya kovidaḥ ॥2-83-22॥

translations.english: As he beheld the army following him and the river Ganga of sacred waters in front of him, Bharata who was proficient in speech said to his ministers:
